title: Seak outfitters

services.name: Wildlife and Whale Watching
services.desc: Enjoy a completely unobstructed view of these awesome animals. From bubble feeding to breaching these whales can put on an amazing show. Come check out these striking black and white beauties in their natural environment. See them playing and hunting fish in family groups. Giving you a chance to spot multiple orcas in one

services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: We offer 4,6, and 8 hour fishing trips. When we push off and head to our fishing grounds you will notice an abundance of life. Bald eagles flying about along with Harbor seals lounging on the docks. One of our primary fishing locations is in direct view of the famous Mendenhall Glacier. When we arrive to the fishing grounds expect to see salmon surfacing and jumping around the boat. King salmon June 1st- July 10th. Pink Salmon/Chum salmon July-August. Coho salmon August-October. You can fly fish, spin cast, or we can troll. The choice is yours. For more information or to book you can reach us at seakoutfitters907@gmail.com or find us on social media @seak_outfitters on Instagram or reach us
